name: IL-07
label: Safe D

key_factors: La Shawn Ford's large fundraising edge over Chad Koppie
Open seat after Danny Davis's retirement
model.rationale: This Chicago-based seat is one of the most Democratic in the country at D+34, and the open-seat dynamic does not change that. Ford has raised over $700,000 while Koppie has raised about $55,000 with almost no cash on hand, and prediction markets price a Democratic win near 97%.
model.watch: A surprise would require an extraordinary scandal or third-party dynamic, neither of which is currently visible.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Danny Davis (D) is not on the ballot.

overview:
Danny Davis's retirement opens this heavily Democratic Chicago seat, but the district's D+34 partisan lean makes the Democratic nominee a heavy favorite regardless. La Shawn Ford enters as the Democratic nominee with a strong financial position, having raised over $700,000, while Republican Chad Koppie has raised only about $55,000 and reported just $42 on hand. Outside spending of roughly $2.5 million opposing Koppie further underscores the lopsided nature of the race.

Prediction markets price a Democratic win at about 97%, and no expert raters list the contest as competitive. With no public polling available, the forecast rests on the district's fundamentals, the fundraising gap, and market pricing, all of which point the same direction. The seat is rated Safe Democratic.
